title: A more realistic phone learning model
summary: Replaced boxy wireframe-like rendering with a rounded phone enclosure, glass display, camera lenses, hardware details and a refined mobile viewer.

changes.detail: Rounded 3D extrusions, face visibility culling, layered lens optics, continuous metal frame, side buttons, port, speaker grilles, screen wallpaper, app tiles, clock and glass reflection.
Replaced average polygon-depth sorting that hid front-screen details. Centered and separated the display and chassis in the opened view; removed full-model selection wireframes.

Larger phone framing, studio-gradient background, compact segmented controls and rounded topic chips. Tapping a part or named topic brings its lesson into view. Existing lessons and saved progress preserved.

validation.name: Initial interaction checks
validation.detail: Existing four phone lab tests passed during implementation.

validation.name: Final checks
validation.detail: Pending final hit-testing regression, typecheck, lint and history retention validation. Direct renderer snapshots are being inspected; no live browser or native-device screenshot verification.
